title: The Branch from Jesse

questions.question: There shall come forth a shoot from the stump of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:1 (ESV): "There shall come forth a shoot from the stump of Jesse,"

questions.question: And the Spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the Spirit of wisdom and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:2 (ESV): "the Spirit of wisdom and understanding,"

questions.question: He shall not judge by what his eyes see, or decide disputes by what his ears what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:3 (ESV): "or decide disputes by what his ears hear,"

questions.question: The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:6 (ESV): "and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat,"

questions.question: They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:9 (ESV): "They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy mountain;"

questions.question: In that day the root of Jesse, who shall stand as a signal for the peoples—of him shall the nations what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:10 (ESV): "of him shall the nations inquire,"

questions.question: And his resting place shall be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:10 (ESV): "and his resting place shall be glorious."

questions.question: In that day the Lord will extend his hand yet a second time to recover the remnant that remains of his people, from where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:11 (ESV): "from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros..."

questions.question: He will raise a signal for the nations and will assemble the banished of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:12 (ESV): "will assemble the banished of Israel"

questions.question: The jealousy of Ephraim shall depart, and those who harass whom shall be cut off?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:13 (ESV): "and those who harass Judah shall be cut off;"

questions.question: Righteousness shall be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:5 (ESV): "and faithfulness the belt of his loins."

questions.question: The cow and the bear shall graze; their young shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:7 (ESV): "and the lion shall eat straw like the ox."

questions.question: The nursing child shall play over the hole of the cobra, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder's what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:8 (ESV): "put his hand on the adder's den."

questions.question: And the LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:15 (ESV): "utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt,"

questions.question: And there will be a highway from Assyria for the remnant that remains of his people, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 11:16 (ESV): "when they came up from the land of Egypt."

key_verse_text: There shall come forth a shoot from the stump of Jesse, and a branch from his roots shall bear fruit.
